functional_unit: one occupied bed-day, 24 hours of reserved communication service
evidence_grade: Illustrative modelled SCI scenarios, not measured electricity/carbon or a certified footprint
grid_note: UBA March 2026, estimated 2025 German mix, GHG including upstream emissions; not the 344 g CO2-only factor
workload_note: Assumed Talk-attempt mix, not observed hospital usage. Every attempt consumes energy, including wrong/rejected predictions.
common_stage_note: Capture/playback/delivery/setup CPU are assumptions. Playback duration comes from WAV metadata where available; no audible output or actual requests.

parameter_sources.board_power_context: https://store.arduino.cc/collections/single-board-computers (advertised 5–12 W; idle/full assignment and linear CPU scaling are unvalidated assumptions)
parameter_sources.board_embodied_context: https://investors.raspberrypi.com/reports (2024 report describes ~6.5 kg non-use footprint for its SBC class; proxy context only, NOT an UNO Q LCA)
parameter_sources.display_identity: Read-only board EDID identified MPI7010. https://www.lcdwiki.com/7inch_HDMI_Display-D. Power and embodied values here are assumed sensitivity scenarios, not measured/model-specific LCA data.
parameter_sources.phone_proxy: https://www.apple.com/environment/pdf/products/iphone/iPhone_15_and_iPhone_15_Plus_PER_Sept2023.pdf (56 kg total, 18% use; ~46 kg non-use proxy, NOT identification of actual caregiver phone)
parameter_sources.unvalidated_inputs: Display/peripheral/router embodied figures, lifespan, shares, power curve, phone use time and common-stage CPU are explicit assumptions. Low/high are scenarios, NOT confidence intervals.
parameter_sources.allocation: Dedicated board/display/peripherals reserved all 24 h; router allocated equally across 20 beds; caregiver phone reserved 30 min per bed-day. All are workload assumptions.
parameter_sources.boundary: Operational equipment and amortized local setup included. Development/research test runs and internet model-download infrastructure excluded from daily service score; their footprint is not claimed zero. Runtime is local. No displaced/avoided nurse trips or carbon offsets credited. No PUE applied to bedside equipment.
